entries.cited_text: Five hundred sixty-one patients were randomly assigned, including 401 patients (71.7%) with EGFR mutation. Median PFS times in EGFR mutation-positive patients receiving gefitinib versus erlotinib were 8.3 and 10.0 months, respectively (HR, 1.093; 95% CI, 0.879 to 1.358; P = .424).
